---
name: Hardware task
about: A bounded implementer task with explicit inputs, write scope and acceptance
title: "[Hardware] "
---

## Outcome and stage

Parent issue/epic, product stage, goal, non-goals and requirement/interface IDs.

## Task contract

Coordinator/implementer, authorized human reviewer, base/dependency commits,
intent/source snapshot and exact tool/ruleset versions.
Use the workflow/task-contract.md template adopted into this project.

## Write scope and ownership

Exact writable paths/resources, current actor/lease and read-only context.
Identify shared CAD files/libraries and parallel tasks.

## Deliverables and acceptance

Sources, schematic/PCB views, calculations, reports, commands/results and observable
acceptance criteria. Name unknowns and the stage they block.

## Review and integration

Assign all four review roles. Link finding ledger, corrections and integration record.
Keep stage approval and merge authorization explicit.

## Closure

- [ ] Deliverables and checks complete for the task's scope
- [ ] Four reviews recorded and blockers/major findings resolved
- [ ] Human acceptance/authorization recorded as applicable
- [ ] PR merged and resulting hashes verified
- [ ] Parent issue updated; no unsupported claim of stage or product completion
